bagPolicy.summary: Travel light as oversized bags are discouraged. Approved bags include small personal bags and clear bags.
allowed: one (1) gallon plastic resealable storage bag
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Street parking is limited along Mount Royal Avenue and nearby streets. The preferred parking option is the Fitzgerald Garage, located at 80 West Oliver Street, which offers ample parking without the need for prepayment or reservation.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Lyric. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: The Lyric in Baltimore offers a variety of standard concession items including fresh made popcorn, soft pretzels, assorted theater box candy, and a selection of beverages such as soda, bottled water, beer, wine, seltzers, and spirits. All food is allowed inside the theater, and bars are located on the first and second floors.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: A limited number of street parking spaces are available along Mount Royal Avenue (including several handicapped-accessible locations) and other nearby streets.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call tickets may be picked up 2 hours prior to the performance you are attending from The Lyric Box Office. For events taking place on Saturdays and Sundays, the Box Office opens three (3) hours before showtime.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Enter the theater through the historic Gutman Lobby entrance. The accessible line is at the far-left door outside The Lyric Box Office, and a ramp to the left inside takes you around the steps.
